intro.en: Hast Rekha AI was born from a simple wish: that every Indian family — from a grandmother in Varanasi to a developer in Bengaluru — should be able to read their own hands and stars in the language they love, without paying consultants or trusting black-box AI.

p.en: We compute real planetary positions with astronomical formulas, apply the classical Lahiri ayanamsa, and combine the result with a rule-based reading of your palm's lines, mounts and marks — producing a complete bilingual report: Rashi, Nakshatra, Lagna, Panchang, life-area predictions and a five-year premium roadmap.

p.en: Transparency: every report shows the exact degrees and ayanamsa behind it. Privacy: your data stays with you. Bilingual first: Hindi and English, written by humans. No fear-mongering: every caution is paired with a remedy. Affordability: the complete free report costs nothing; the premium 5-year roadmap is a one-time ₹51.
